title: Beethoven catalogue

measurements.how_measured: counted ink hues inside border and visually estimated solid black area versus paper white, ignoring paper grain
measurements.statement: only black ink on off-white paper with no gray shading; flat black dominates the illustration
measurements.value: 2 tones total; black covers ~55-65% of illustration area

measurements.how_measured: compared illustration box edges to paper edges left-to-right and top-to-bottom
measurements.statement: one large rectangular illustration dominates the page with narrow side margins and larger bottom paper margin
measurements.value: block spans ~80% of page width and ~75% of page height; bottom margin ~1.5x top margin

measurements.how_measured: traced contiguous white shape from forehead through neck and torso to raised arm holding skull against black ground
measurements.statement: pale figure forms a continuous thick V-curve with face in upper third right of center and skull held at middle left
measurements.value: white ribbon runs from upper-right to lower-center to middle-left; face and skull occupy opposite sides of center

measurements.how_measured: observed dark perimeter line tight to artwork on all four sides versus paper margin
measurements.statement: illustration is enclosed by a thin hand-drawn black rule tight to the artwork
measurements.value: rule thickness ~1/300 of page height; inset ~5% from paper edge on sides

measurements.how_measured: read letterforms below border for serif, stroke, weight and spacing and compared cap-height and line width to page and block
measurements.statement: caption below is small all-caps low-contrast serif with even monoline stroke, medium weight, slightly condensed width, visibly letterspaced and centered
measurements.value: cap-height ~1/60 of page height; line spans ~75% of page width centered below border

hypotheses.statement: Absolute black-versus-paper contrast with no midtones creates a stark, ominous mood and makes the pale face and skull read instantly as linked foci.
The continuous thick pale ribbon from face down to torso and up to the skull drives a looping eye rhythm between upper-right and middle-left across the dark field.
A single bordered block dominating the page with only a tiny centered caption below establishes an art-plate hierarchy where image overwhelms text.

relations.rule: limit composition to two flat values with no gradients, with dark value covering about half of image area
link two focal elements with one continuous thick light curve across a dark field to force back-and-forth eye movement
let one bordered image occupy >70% of height and reduce text to a single small centered line below the border

fragile_if_changed: Replacing the flat solid-black ground with soft gray shading or gradients would collapse the stark figure-ground reversal that gives the image its character.

regions.label: pale figure ribbon face to skull

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'illustration ink field': none found (1 px), so accent = fg
